acceptance_criteria: AC1 — `/` renders all 11 sections in order without omitted prototype element groups.
AC2 — Content, hierarchy, styling and visual composition closely follow the prototype across viewports.
AC3 — Hero copy, CTAs, trust points and collage are complete without destructive overlap.
AC4 — Occasions has 8 items; Templates and Gifts have 6 cards with required metadata/controls.
AC5 — Editor, QR Story, How it works and Blog are complete mandatory sections.
AC6 — Template filters work accessibly without breaking the section.
AC7 — Favorite/add-to-cart use shared ShopProvider state and update shared badges consistently.
AC8 — Slider controls/dots and newsletter invalid/success feedback work.
AC9 — Search opening does not change header/content geometry or scroll.
AC10 — Search is responsive, autofocuses, dismisses correctly, restores focus and submits the current query.
AC11 — Search button remains available and the form is out of normal flow.
AC12 — The full page is usable without overflow/clipping/overlap/hidden controls at all three required viewports.
AC13 — Semantics, accessible state/focus and reduced motion meet repository baseline.
AC14 — Completeness/search regression tests and lint/typecheck/test/build pass.
AC15 — Handoff includes accurate mapping and reproducible before/after visual evidence at all three viewports.

risk_areas.evidence: Full 2,018-line prototype, all changed section sources, and persisted screenshots were inspected; material layout/control mismatches are findings.
Tailwind breakpoints were compared with prototype media queries and 375/768/1440 artifacts; mobile search and full-page evidence gaps are identified.

risk_areas.area: accessibility, keyboard, focus and reduced motion
risk_areas.evidence: Search/Popover/Carousel/Reveal behavior and tests were inspected; focus and reduced-motion paths pass, while HowItWorks has invalid list structure.
CodeGraph traces HomePage through MarketingLayout/ShopProvider to SiteHeader badges; tests assert independent favorite/cart updates.
All CodeGraph consumers and current UI tests were inspected; default menu role and scroll locking remain unchanged for existing callers.
All changed CTAs/search submissions were checked against PUBLIC_ROUTES and Next router behavior; encoded and empty search queries are tested.

risk_areas.area: input validation, XSS, secrets and PII
risk_areas.evidence: Newsletter/search inputs are rendered as React text and URL-encoded; no secret-bearing file, HTML injection, credential storage, auth boundary, or external write was introduced.

risk_areas.area: API, database, migration, transaction and concurrency
risk_areas.evidence: The diff is presentation-only and uses in-memory mock ShopProvider state; no API/database/persistence contract or transactional boundary changed.
summary.json reports lint/typecheck/test/build passed and provenance covers 26 artifacts; the required UI fidelity matrix/reference evidence is nevertheless absent.
Announcement, mobile drawer, account popover, footer and mobile bottom navigation dependencies/tests were inspected; no code regression found beyond missing mobile search access.

test_contract.scenario: Render `/` and enumerate labelled section landmarks.
test_contract.expected_result: Exactly 11 sections render in prototype order with one h1 and per-section h2 headings.

test_contract.scenario: Compare the banner's CTA group with the prototype.
test_contract.expected_result: Both `Gửi ý tưởng của bạn` and `Xem sản phẩm đã thực hiện` affordances are retained with valid route/fallback semantics.

test_contract.scenario: Compare all changed sections with the prototype at 1440x900.
test_contract.expected_result: Content hierarchy, card composition, section surfaces, typography and controls closely match the prototype.

test_contract.scenario: Compare section adaptations at 375x812.
test_contract.expected_result: Occasions becomes the prototype snap scroller and HowItWorks retains a clear vertical connected flow without overlap/overflow.

test_contract.scenario: Inspect hero copy, CTAs, trust points and all collage pieces at required viewports.
test_contract.expected_result: All required elements render without clipping or covering operable content.

test_contract.scenario: Render Occasions, Templates and Gifts in their default states.
test_contract.expected_result: 8 occasion items and 6 template/gift articles render with required controls/metadata.

test_contract.scenario: Select a non-default style filter.
test_contract.expected_result: aria-pressed moves to the selected tab and only matching cards remain without replacing the section landmark.

test_contract.scenario: Favorite a template from HomePage.
test_contract.expected_result: The shared SiteHeader favorites badge increments and the card reports pressed state.

test_contract.scenario: Add a featured gift to cart from HomePage.
test_contract.expected_result: Shared cart count increases by one without mutating favorites.

test_contract.scenario: Use previous, next, dot and keyboard navigation across boundaries.
test_contract.expected_result: Slides wrap correctly and active dot/slide accessible state stays synchronized.

test_contract.scenario: Submit invalid then valid email input.
test_contract.expected_result: Invalid input announces an error; valid input announces success and clears the field.

test_contract.scenario: Open search at tablet and desktop while recording header/main geometry and scroll.
test_contract.expected_result: Header height/bottom and main position/scroll are unchanged.

test_contract.scenario: At 375x812, locate, open, dismiss and submit search.
test_contract.expected_result: A visible operable trigger opens a responsive out-of-flow surface and supports the full search contract.

test_contract.target: Search focus, dismissal and query submission
test_contract.scenario: Open search, autofocus input, dismiss by Escape/outside/control, restore focus, and submit encoded/empty query.
test_contract.expected_result: All paths work and body scroll remains unlocked.

test_contract.scenario: Existing menu Popovers, Dialogs and Drawers use the extended hook without new props.
test_contract.expected_result: Default menu role and scroll lock remain unchanged; focus/dismiss suites stay green.

test_contract.scenario: Run with missing observer, reduced-motion preference, and normal intersection.
test_contract.expected_result: Content is always available in fallbacks and animates only in the supported normal path.

test_contract.scenario: Validate semantic structure of the three-step ordered list.
test_contract.expected_result: The ol contains valid list-item children and assistive technology receives an ordered three-step list.

initial_findings.title: The search workflow is unavailable at the required 375px mobile viewport
initial_findings.expected_fix: Provide an operable mobile search trigger/surface with the same focus, dismiss, submit and no-layout-shift contract at 375x812.

initial_findings.title: Multiple changed sections materially diverge from the prototype's required responsive composition
initial_findings.expected_fix: Align the changed sections' desktop/tablet/mobile composition, content and control hierarchy with the prototype while retaining accessible React architecture.

initial_findings.title: Custom order drops the prototype's second CTA
initial_findings.expected_fix: Render both prototype custom-order CTA affordances using an available route or an explicitly documented accessible fallback.

initial_findings.title: Required reproducible UI fidelity evidence is missing
initial_findings.expected_fix: Provide a complete, reproducible fidelity matrix and durable reference/actual evidence for all required viewports and states.

initial_findings.title: How-it-works renders invalid ordered-list structure
initial_findings.expected_fix: Keep every direct ol child semantically valid while rendering the decorative connector outside the list-item content model.
